paragraphs: Objective Corporation sells software meant to help government shift to being completely digital. It says thousands of public sector organizations use its software for developing policies with impact and accelerating processes. One of its stated aims is to streamline the building assessment and consent process.

Objective Trapeze is electronic plan review software that helps planning and building departments review plans quickly and accurately while checking compliance with ICC codes and amendments. Stamping is digital, and a 100-page application can be stamped in a few mouse clicks, with the software finding white space to place the stamp. Objective Connect is an IRAP assessed external file sharing product that gives control over information shared outside a council. Objective RegWorks centralises, tracks and administers the compliance process, including education and engagement. A separate product keeps disclosure document management production, review, verification and publication in one central system.

The company states that more than 500 local governments in the UK, Australia and New Zealand rely on Objective Trapeze to conduct plan reviews faster. It puts the file sharing product at more than 200 organisations worldwide.
